name: Build docs
author: Brett
description: Right-click any built build or step (Build manager, Build orchestrator, Pending builds, Plan Studio, Codebase changes) and pick Create documentation or Create walkthrough video; several builds and single steps at once. Docs: Markdown from Brett's words, the steps, the report, the diff and the screens and commands the build added (AI in deep mode, a template otherwise), as a pull request through the merge queue into the plugin's or app's docs/ folder, linked in the build's plan. Video: pick the length, what to cover, viewport, theme, layout, narration voice, captions, speed and intro/outro; approve the click-path script, then a real headless browser session is recorded on the VPS (the walkthrough recorder: Playwright, Piper, ffmpeg) in a heavy slot and the MP4 attaches to the plan. Docs & videos lists every job with progress, cancel and re-run with tweaks. Jobs and videos live on the VPS data volume.
